_doc: Trainer battle definitions. '$rival_starter' resolves to the type-advantaged counter of the player's starter at battle start.

rival_sable_1.name: Sable
rival_sable_1.reward_text: Sable: Tch. Enjoy it while it lasts. The Scald will eat you alive.

scald_acolyte.name: Ashen Acolyte
scald_acolyte.reward_text: Acolyte: The Warden's flame burns far hotter than mine. Go see for yourself.

warden_brask.name: Warden Brask
warden_brask.reward_text: Brask: Well fought, hatchling. The EMBER SIGIL is yours — the first of eight.
